The docket on your screen lists what he will do next, in order: three attacks, then five in his last phase. Each one's mark appears on the floor three seconds early. Read it and stand where it isn't.
It is honest, almost. Once a phase he revises it: one line is struck through, and a moment later something else takes its place.

The Termination Notice is the one to fear. The hunter it names is smitten five seconds later for two fifths of their strength, unless they stand at one of the desks that are safe from it, or share it: everyone within three blocks of them takes a part of the blow.
Pass his test and he types your ending. "The End" is the chronicle of your hunt as he saw it: the enemies you beat, what you killed, the deals you made. Use it to read.

The Author's Pen rewrites a small corner of the world. Sneak and use it to choose: the land (the biome around the block you touch), the sky (clear day, rain, storm, clear night) or a creature (into another of its kind; never a great enemy, never a person). Every rewrite takes a long while to dry.

Sam's amulet, worn as a necklace (or in hand without Curios), gives four hearts and shows you the powerful - great enemies and the strange things of this world - through walls, and shines when one is near.
These are given once to each hunter, for their first victory. He will gladly fight you again - another draft - but for you the props department is closed.
The End, the Pen, the amulet
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_mark: Taken from Cain as he dies, or later at his grave, it burns into the forearm. Every Knight of Hell bears it, and the Knight's rite will not take a Prince who does not already.

The Mark thirsts. For five minutes after a kill it rests; then its Thirst climbs a hundredth every minute. Every kill slakes it, a hundredth for each soul the victim was worth (two at least, thirty at most), and Cain's honey takes a quarter off. The more it thirsts, the less healing does: at its worst, only half.

From half Thirst you are in bloodlust: your blows land a fifth harder, it whispers, and a demon's Corruption drains and will not come back. At full it feeds on you, a point of health every ten seconds. Die at full Thirst as a human, or as an angel whose grace it burns out, and you do not stay dead: you rise a demon, and the Thirst is left at half.

The First Blade answers it: in a Marked hand it strikes three times as hard and never hungers, for the Mark's Thirst takes the blade's place. A Mark that was ever taken off and is taken again remembers the way: it comes back already at half.
There is a cure in the Book of the Damned, if a witch will read it for you: see Unmark. A Knight whose Mark is taken off stays a Knight.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_mess: At the first dawn after you first bring Azazel down, an angel comes to you: a tired man in a trench coat, with the shadow of wings behind him. He cannot be hurt, and he only wants to talk. He offers you Grace.

Hear him out and he gives you a Vial of Grace and the way to take it in. Turn him away and he comes back three dawns later. Once heeded he no longer comes on his own, but a spell at the bowl can call him again. He never comes to a demon.
An angel in a borrowed trench coat
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.the_tric: Ever since Lucifer went back in his box, little things have been happening. A candy wrapper by your feet when you haven't eaten any candy. A party hat on a cow. A laugh track somewhere out of sight. A villager quoting a soap opera. A chest that opens and shuts on its own, with nothing missing from it.

None of it breaks anything, takes anything or hurts anyone, and it never happens more than once a day. That is how you know it is not a ghost: it's a Trickster, a pagan god of mischief who plays his jokes on the people who deserve them, and he has noticed you.

Notice three of his pranks and you're on his trail. He can't resist sweets: cook a bait for him in a small circle with three sugar, a honey bottle, cocoa beans, holy oil and a gold nugget, lit with flint and steel.
What he leaves lying around, and what he can't resist
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.training: Naomi tests her work. Copies rise on the training floor: some kneel with their hands up, wearing the faces of people you would never hurt (Dean, Sam, Castiel, a pet you lost, you yourself); the others are hunters with demons' black eyes, and they come for you.

Strike a kneeling copy and the test has worked: you are Conditioned for ten seconds (your blows against angels fall soft) and she heals. Kill every hostile copy within fifteen seconds without touching one that kneels, and the result is unexpected: she is stunned for three seconds and takes more from every blow.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.trickste: His candy, in a striped wrapper. Eat one and something happens for a little while: always something good, or at least nothing bad. You never know which. That is the point.

His remote control. Point it at a creature and change its channel: it might shrink for a while, turn up in a silly costume, or become another creature of its size altogether. It needs half a minute between uses, and it never works on a great enemy, a named creature or a villager with a trade.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.trophies: Every great one leaves its likeness behind, a little statue to set on a shelf and remember the night by.
Do not get too attached to three of them. War wants Lucifer's, Famine the Darkness's and Pestilence the Chorus's.
Watch the corner of your eye: when the static clears, the channel's number is there, and every channel has its own rule. The banner at the top is his health; the sign under it is the studio's.

CH 2, the Sitcom. A living room, a staircase, doors, and an audience. While the LAUGH sign is lit he can't be touched and plays his gags: pies in the face that blind you, banana peels, a piano from the ceiling (watch for its shadow), extras through the doors. When the sign goes dark he takes more from every blow. Keep hitting him: if nobody touches him for a few seconds, the APPLAUSE sign lights and the audience heals him.

CH 5, Nutcracker! A Japanese game show over a pit of foam: three platforms, red, blue and yellow. Every so often a question appears with three answers, one on each colour. Stand on the right platform before the buzzer: you come away stronger and he is stunned for a moment. Stand on a wrong one, or none, and the trap door or the giant mallet finds you. Fight him between the rounds. The questions are about everything in this book.

CH 7, Dr. Sexy, M.D. A hospital ward with a giant heart monitor. Strike him on the beep (the trace on your screen spikes; the lit band in its middle is your moment) and the blow is critical. The beat quickens as the episode goes on. The defibrillator shocks marked zones of the floor; and nurses, doubles of him in caps, walk to him to heal him: one blow stops a nurse.

CH 9, A Word from Our Sponsor. A white stage with five podiums and five spokesmen, all of him; only the real one casts a shadow of six golden wings. Strike a double and the joke is on you, and the podiums shuffle. They shuffle when you strike the real one too, and every ten seconds. Watch the floor, not the faces.

A human's free will sees through his tricks a little: in the commercial, one more double flickers and fades for them. Demons are cast as the episode's villain and take more from him; an angel's grace drains in his commercial breaks, little brother.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.unmark.0: The cure for the Mark of Cain, out of the Book of the Damned. Only a witch who outlived your witch fight can work it: Rowena if you gave her the Book and the Grand Witch fell, the Grand Witch if you kept it and Rowena fell. The price is a vial of your own bound blood.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.unmark.1: The simple way is to ask her. Rowena does it in her house; the Grand Witch wherever she stands, reading from the Book you kept, so carry it. Either takes the vial from your pack.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.unmark.2: Or speak it at a bowl yourself, with the witch within eight blocks of it and, if you kept the Book, the Book on you (it is not spent). Dragon's breath, honey and holy water; your bound blood, an echo shard, an amethyst shard and a ghast tear; a hundred and fifty mana. It is a Master's page found in no chest: Rowena sells it only to an ally who saw the Grand Witch fall, for thirty-two emeralds, eight gold and an echo shard.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.unmarked: The Mark is gone. My arm is just an arm. The First Blade is just a very old bone.
If I was a Knight of Hell I still am: the rank stays, the Thirst does not. Nobody will put the Mark back on me behind my back.
Cain's grave would still give it to me if I asked. It would come back hungry, half-way to bloodlust from the first day. I am not going to ask.
Rowena would say I owe her. She would be right. She usually is.
Pale, quick and hungry, they nest in barns and mines and keep to the dark. When they feed a second row of teeth slides down over the first, and a bite leaves you bleeding.

Weakness: only a beheading keeps one down. Kill it with a sword, an axe or a silver machete in your hand, or it goes down and rises again ten seconds later. Dead man's blood (used on it, or smeared on a blade held in your other hand) stuns it cold. Brew it from glass bottles, rotten flesh, a bone and redstone.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.vitality: Every great enemy you outlive makes you harder to kill. The first time each of them falls, everyone who fought it gains two hearts of health for good; the Trickster, who was only playing, gives one. Dying does not take them back.
By the time you knock on the Author's door you will carry twenty-five more hearts than you started with. You will need every one.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.0: A man in a red suit with a sword at his hip, who makes neighbours kill each other for fun. Once Lucifer has fallen, call him in a great circle with iron swords, demon blood and gunpowder, lit with flint and steel.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.1: He lays a battlefield over the arena: trenches, wire, craters. His sword comes in combos he shows you first. Raise a shield just as a blow lands and he staggers: for three seconds he takes half again as much.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.2: Then his four standards rise. Every blow he takes and every standard left standing makes him angrier, faster and harder-hitting; break them. And he gets into your head: for a while every other hunter looks like a demon, and mirages walk the field, some hostile, some innocent. The innocent never strike and kneel where they stand. Hit an innocent or a friend and the blow comes back on you.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war.3: At the end he mounts his red horse and charges across the field, sweeping his sword, setting the trenches alight.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.war_tabl: Set nine map table pieces down in a square and they lock together into a war table: dark glass with a projector under it, and over the glass a hologram of the land for a mile and more around, its hills and rivers and seas. Where the land has been seen, the picture is sharp; where it has only been foretold, it flickers. Break any piece and the table comes apart.
Your cases are on it: the open one as a red light with a line run to it from the table, the closed ones dim. Look at the glass and it tells you what you are looking at and how far it is.
Use the table to open it. Drag the map, zoom it, ask for a case and read its brief. Double-click the map to stick a pin in it: the pins belong to the table, and everyone who uses it sees them.

A Letters compass points at your open case. Carry one to the table and you can set it on any pin instead (and back on the case). Use it to hear what it points at and how far; sneak and use it to let a pin go. In an outsider's hand, with no case, or away from the world above, its needle only spins.

A case can be abandoned there too. It is filed as gone cold, and the order gives you no other before the next dawn. The bunker's table stands in its war room; researching the order's cartography gives you the blueprint to build another anywhere in the world above. The blueprint comes back out of the crafting grid.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.warded_r: A circle broken mid-rite lashes out: thunder, a burn, and now and then something comes through. Cast a Ward of your own over the altar before you light it and the Ward takes the backlash: no burn, and nothing answers. The rite is still lost, and so are its offerings.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.werewolf: By day a lean, unshaven man who keeps to himself. At night his bones crack and he turns into a hulking wolf with yellow eyes, strongest under a full moon.
Weakness: silver, and only silver, ends it. Anything else drives it off at the last; it flees, licks its wounds and comes back whole.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.wild_bar: Better wishes, worse prices. Besides everything the bowl's demon offers, a wild one can raise the weapon in your hand one tier of Ascension (never past the fourth, nor past what you have earned); give you the trophies of up to three great enemies you have already beaten, with a shard for each; bring back the last pet you lost, collar or not; or lift a curse: a hungry weapon's, Heaven's Mark, the hollowness of a soul taken, or a jinx.

The price: half the usual days before the hounds come, the soul clause already ticked, and a bigger pack (five to seven) that you must outlast for three minutes, not two. Sealing one is a Wild Bargain.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.wild_cro: The bowl is the quick way. The old way still works, out where two dirt roads meet in open country, far from any town: a weathered marker, a dead tree, and in the very middle a patch of loose, dark soil that nothing grows on.

Fill a crossroads box: a bone, grave soil, paper, sulfur and an iron nugget. Bury it in that soil at night and stay close: a few moments later the demon comes up the road, and no bowl or contract is asked of you. A crossroads takes one box from you a night; walk off before it comes and the box is wasted.
A wild demon offers more than the one in the bowl, and charges more for it (Wild Bargains, in this book).
The box, and where it goes
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.witch_co: Binding of the Name roots whoever the bowl names for twenty seconds, if they are within two hundred and fifty-six blocks in this world. A boss is never held, though one or two can be checked for a breath.

Banish by Name sends the named away as the banishing rites would: a ghost laid to rest, a demon or a hound cast back into the dark, a lesser angel sent home, a demon player expelled (it hurts, and burns their Corruption away), an angel player flung far. Never a boss, never a crossroads demon (only its death breaks a deal), never anything of this world.
Compel makes a creature, the named one or else the nearest within eight blocks of the bowl, follow you and spare you for a minute. A named player is drawn slowly toward the bowl for five seconds.

Break Hex frees the named, or you, of every curse of the craft (jinx, bleeding, agony, rot, silence, marks, compulsion, bad luck) and burns the curse bags within eight blocks of the bowl and of them, and any they carry.

Deep in swamps, dark forests and old taiga, the witches gather: three huts round a ring of standing stones and a working spell bowl, bones in the grass. Two to four hedge witches keep it with their familiars; in about a third of them a coven witch leads. Their victims shuffle at the edges.
Go in with salt and something to turn a curse. Burn the familiars first; break the coven witch's bubble before you waste blows on it.
The bowl is real, and yours to use once its keepers are gone.
Their chests: pages, taglocks, hexed ink, blood, bags
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.witch_cu: A curse is aimed. Put something of your victim's in the bowl with the rest: a dose of their blood poured in beyond what the spell asks for, or a taglock of their hair. Without it the bowl will not catch. With it, the curse finds them anywhere in the world, so long as they are somewhere awake.

It is refused by the great ones, every boss, and by other hunters unless the world allows them to fight each other. A Ward of the Name turns it away: the curse fails and you take a heart and a half for trying. A Mirror Hex sends it back on you, once.
Agony hurts every two seconds but, like poison, never kills. Break Hex lifts any of them.
Misfortune: bad luck and a jinx, five minutes
Frailty: weakness, slow hands, and a fifth more harm, two minutes
Rot: hunger, a little poison, and the food in their pack rots, two minutes
Silence: no sigils and no powers, a minute
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.witch_tr: Locate Being is the Locating spell for anyone at all, player or creature: water, a compass, string and salt, and something of theirs.

Scrying shows you in the smoke where they are in this world: the land they stand in and roughly where, and it outlines them for thirty seconds for everyone to see. A Ward of the Name veils its bearer.
Trace the Familiar needs nothing of anyone's: the smoke leads to the nearest witch, or a witch's bound familiar, within a hundred and sixty blocks.
journal.supernaturalcraft.entry.zacharia: Heaven's middle management: a balding angel in a grey suit who believes in procedure and in nothing else. Every prophecy has a form, every form has a cabinet, and every hunter is a file he would like to close.

Once Naomi has fallen, the lift at the back of her room goes up to his office: rows of desks and cubicles under flat white light, and they do not end. Walk far enough in any direction and you come back in from the other side. He does not need to walk: he blinks. Nobody else's road needs him.
Everyone in his office does paperwork. He hands each of you a Heavenly Form, and while you hold one that is not filed, your blows are worth a quarter. File it (Heavenly Forms, in this book).

I. Intake. A storm of memos in a cone. A rubber stamp slams a square of floor: DENIED, and your wounds stop closing for a while. Clerks come to help him. He strikes where you stand now, and again where you stood three seconds ago. He hands one of you a Termination Notice.
II. Review. The cubicles shuffle round you and block your sight; he reassigns you across the office.
III. It Was Already Written. His six wings open, and they buffet. From now on he tells you what comes next: read the docket (The Docket, in this book).
IV. Final Judgment. The office comes apart, there is only a golden sky, and he smites Heaven itself in lines of gold that run out from him: find the ring of safe floor between them.
Once he has fallen, the lift carries you up to an empty office. Crouch as you ride it to call him back.
Met again, he leaves his bust, and now and then his blade or his seal. Like every great enemy, he also leaves a shard and, the first time, a heart. His fall makes your house in Heaven your home.
What he leaves the first time

An ornate silver angel blade, a holy weapon of the fourth tier. Every third blow files its target: for three seconds it takes a quarter more from everything. Raise it at the Hellforge and the filing bites deeper.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.case.title: Case File No. %s
legacy.supernaturalcraft.case.twist.host: Someone was taken alive. Get them out before it's too late.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.case.twist.name: Witnesses speak of one who gives the orders, and of a name.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.case.twist.seco: The deaths don't all match: something else is out there too.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.case_give: Here is the file, and a map of the place. Read the file on the way.
Mind what you're up against. A vampire wants its head off, a werewolf wants silver, and a shapeshifter wants to be found out before anything else.
Field notes from the scene come back here, to the archive. Good hunting.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.case_lost: The trail went cold, did it? It happens to the best of us.
No shame in it. Shall we try another?
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.case_open: You still have a case open, I'm afraid. The file has the map, and the map has the place.
Finish that one first. We don't leave a job half done in this order.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.case_solv: Well done. A clean job, by the sound of it, and the file is closed.
Your notes are in the archive; take them to the desk in the library. There is always more to learn from what we kill.
I understand. It is a great deal to ask of anyone.
I'll call again in a few days. Do try to stay alive until then.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.offer.1: Good morning. Forgive the hour, and the intrusion. My name is Henry Winchester.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.offer.2: I am a Legacy of the Men of Letters: a brotherhood of scholars who studied the things that go bump in the night, so that men like you could put them down.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.offer.3: Word travels, even to us. You stood against the Devil himself, and you walked away. That is not luck. That is a hunter.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.offer.4: We kept our knowledge in a bunker in open country, built to outlast anything. It has sat locked for far too long.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.offer.5: I am offering you a place among us: the key, the library, the war room, and every secret we ever wrote down. Will you take it?
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.offer_aga: Good morning again. I did say I would come back, and a Winchester keeps his word.
The offer stands. The archive does not read itself, and the things out there are not waiting for us to make up our minds.
So: will you take up the Legacy?
Ah, there you are. Pull up a chair.
The map table never sleeps: missing persons, strange deaths, cattle drained of blood. Somebody has to look into them.
Shall I give you a case?
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.welcome.1: Splendid. Then welcome to the Men of Letters, Aspirant.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.welcome.2: Here is the key. Don't lose it; there is only the one, and the door was built to keep out worse than burglars.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.welcome.3: And a map. The bunker lies out in the open country, beneath a little stone hut that nobody ever looks at twice.
legacy.supernaturalcraft.henry.welcome.4: I'll be waiting for you in the war room, by the map table. Read everything. Then we'll talk about cases.

memory.supernaturalcraft.title.boss_vict: The Storm in the Old House
message.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.busy: Another fight already holds this world: the smoke sinks back into the ground.
message.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.cage_g: The fight is over. Abaddon is smoke again, and the smoke is gone.
message.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.cast_o: Abaddon is thrown back into her own body, reeling!
message.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.expell: You drive Abaddon out of her knight!
message.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.trappe: The devil's trap holds her! Every blow lands in full.
message.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.victor: Abaddon: "Run along, little hunter. I'll find you when I'm bored."
message.supernaturalcraft.allegiance.ban: The sigil flares and hurls you far away!
message.supernaturalcraft.allegiance.bos: Abaddon: "Oh, a feathered one. I used to eat your kind for breakfast."
Abaddon: "Kneel, soldier. Hell has a queen again."
Abaddon: "Another Winchester wannabe. Adorable."
Amara: "His light, in a little vessel. I will drink it."
Amara: "A creature of the dark, come to the Darkness. You are almost home."
Amara: "A human soul. Warm. I could hold it forever."
Azazel: "A feathered little soldier. Heaven sends its errand boys to do its killing now?"
Azazel: "Well, look at you. A crossroads dog, biting the hand that made the road."
Azazel: "A hunter with a rank. Your daddy would be so proud. Shame he won't see you die."
The Chorus sings one note at you, in recognition. Then a hundred, in judgement.
The Chorus falls silent at the sight of you. The silence is worse.
The Chorus sings over you as if you were not there.
Cain: "An angel. You lot never could stand that God liked my brother's offering better."
Cain: "A demon. I made your kind's Knights. I can unmake one."
Cain: "A hunter. I'll go easy. At first."
Chuck: "Wings, Grace, all of it. I gave you that. I can take it back."
Chuck: "Hell, Corruption, the whole bit. I gave you that. You know that, right?"
Chuck: "A hunter. Always my favourite character. Let's see how it ends."
Death: "Angels die too. I've reaped more of your kind than you have brothers."
Death: "A demon. I'll take you back to where you came from, and further."
Death: "Hunter. I'm going to reap God someday. You won't be any trouble."
Famine: "An angel never hungers. I'll teach you."
Famine: "Demons. Always hungry for one more soul. Let me feed."
Famine: "Hunters. Whiskey, burgers and grief. You're starving, kid."
Gabriel: "Little brother! Look at you, all wings and no sense of humour. You'll miss every commercial break."
Gabriel: "Every episode needs a villain, and look who walked on set. Hit your mark, demon. You're the bad guy tonight."
Gabriel: "Free will, huh? Sure. Change the channel, then. Oh, wait. You can't."
The Grand Witch: "Heaven sends its pets now? How quaint."
The Grand Witch: "The Coven does not bargain with demons."
The Grand Witch: "Rowena's little hunter. How touching."
Lilith: "An angel. Do you know what your brothers did to me? Come closer, I'll show you."
Lilith: "You're one of mine and you raise a blade to me? I'll make you a hellhound's chew toy."
Lilith: "A real hunter. I've worn a few of you. You fit like a glove."
Lucifer: "Brother. Little brother. They sent you to put me back in my box?"
Lucifer: "One of my children. Let's see if you know who your father is."
Lucifer: "Free will. My Father's favourite toy. Let's see how free you are."
Lucifer: "Pity. You'd have made a fine prince."
He lets you go, laughing.
"Thank you." He is inside you. Your body is not yours.
Lucifer: "Out of the Cage, brother. And you came all this way to see me."
Lucifer: "Kneel, child. The Cage is open, and your King is home."
Lucifer: "Still human. Still free. Still so small."
Metatron: "A seraph who reads! No? Pity. I'd have written you a better part."
Metatron: "A demon in my library. I'll write you out in a single line."
Metatron: "The hunter. Every story has one, and every hunter dies in the second act."
Michael: "Soldier. Stand with your General, or fall with my brother."
Michael: "An abomination, at the gates of Heaven. I'll end it myself."
Michael: "A human with no yes to give me. Then you are only in my way."

message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.needs_m: This rite asks for the Mark of Cain on the one who performs it.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.needs_n: This rite can only be performed at night.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.needs_r: This rite can only be performed in the rain.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.needs_t: This rite can only be performed in a thunderstorm.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.no_mana: You lack the mana to begin this rite.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.not_rea: You aren't ready for this rite yet.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.unanswe: The rite ends, and nothing answers.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.unknown: This ritual names a circle no one has drawn before.
message.supernaturalcraft.ritual.wrong_d: This rite cannot be performed here.
message.supernaturalcraft.rowena.cage_go: The fight is over. Rowena laughs from somewhere, and the smoke is gone.
message.supernaturalcraft.rowena.challen: Another fight already holds this world: the house stays quiet.
Read it in her house or her garden, where she can hear it.
The pages are silent. This Book answers only the one who kept it from her.
The house is quiet. She only answers after dark.
message.supernaturalcraft.rowena.recitat: Rowena begins to recite over her bowls. Break them!
The last bowl shatters — Rowena falls out of the air!
message.supernaturalcraft.rowena.victim_: The hex breaks and rebounds on Rowena!
The hexed soul dies — and its life flows into Rowena!
message.supernaturalcraft.rowena.victori: Rowena: "Off you pop, darling. Do come back when you've learnt some manners."
message.supernaturalcraft.rowenas_grimoi: The pages are blank: speak an aimed spell at a bowl first.
The words have faded from its pages.
message.supernaturalcraft.scrying.veiled: The smoke parts around %s: something veils them.
message.supernaturalcraft.scrying.vision: The smoke shows you %s, in the %s, near %s, %s, %s.
message.supernaturalcraft.spell_page.ill: The words on this page make no sense.
message.supernaturalcraft.spell_page.lea: You have learned the words of %s.
message.supernaturalcraft.stake.no_room: No room for %s: it will wait for you. Make some space.
message.supernaturalcraft.stake.returned: What you offered comes back to you: %s.
message.supernaturalcraft.taglock.notice: Something tugs at your hair. It was %s.
message.supernaturalcraft.taglock.snippe: You snip a lock of %s's hair.
message.supernaturalcraft.trickster.tv_l: I'm not a doctor, but I play one on TV.
We'll be right back after these messages.
Did you hear the studio audience? Nobody else did either.
This program was brought to you by Trickster Treats.
message.supernaturalcraft.uncaged.free: The Cage is open. He is coming down.
message.supernaturalcraft.uncaged.victor: He goes back into the Cage on his own. The Rings are left on the stone.
message.supernaturalcraft.unmark.done: The Mark of Cain burns one last time — and is gone.
message.supernaturalcraft.unmark.needs_b: The cure needs a vial of the Marked's own bound blood.
The cure is read from the Book of the Damned: it must be at hand.
message.supernaturalcraft.unmark.no_surv: Only the witch who survived your choice can read this cure.
The witch who must read the cure is not here.
message.supernaturalcraft.unmark.not_mar: There is no Mark to take off.
message.supernaturalcraft.vitality: Having survived %s, you are harder to kill: +%s max hearts.
message.supernaturalcraft.war.betrayal: You struck a friend. War laughs.
message.supernaturalcraft.war.busy: Another fight already holds this world.
message.supernaturalcraft.war.cage_gone: The field falls quiet. He is gone.
message.supernaturalcraft.war.innocent: That was no demon. The blow comes back on you.
message.supernaturalcraft.war.marked: War whispers in your ear. Everyone around you is a demon now...
message.supernaturalcraft.war.parry: You turned his blade aside: he's open!
message.supernaturalcraft.war.standard: His standard falls; his fury cools.
message.supernaturalcraft.war.victorious: "Give it time. You'll do my work for me." He rides off the field.
message.supernaturalcraft.whisper.6: Can you hear them? They hear you.
message.supernaturalcraft.whistle.alread: A hound already runs at your side.
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.bos: %s is far too strong for a bowl's curse.
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.els: %s is in another world, beyond the smoke's reach.
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.mir: A mirror hex on %s throws the curse back at you!
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.no_: There is no curse on %s to break.
Your magic will not touch %s: this world forbids harming other hunters.
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.not: There is nothing near the bowl to compel.
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.of_: %s is of this world: there is nowhere to banish it to.
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.too: %s is too far away for the spell to take hold.
message.supernaturalcraft.witchcraft.war: %s is warded. The curse turns back on you!
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.appr: Filed. APPROVED: your blows land harder for a while.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.busy: Another fight already holds this office. Take a number.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.cage: The office empties. Somewhere, a file is closed without you.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.deni: DENIED. Your wounds will not close until the paperwork clears.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.file: Filed on a colleague's behalf. They are Approved.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.form: Zachariah hands you a Heavenly Form: file it in cabinet %s.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.noth: You have no form waiting to be stamped.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.noti: A Termination Notice, with your name on it. Find an Approved desk, or someone to share it with.
The notice comes due, and you take your share of it.
You stand at an Approved desk: the notice is void.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.offi: The drawer is locked: nobody is processing forms right now.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.over: Your form is overdue. Heaven is coming to collect.
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.vict: Zachariah: "Your request has been denied. Have a blessed day."
message.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.wron: This is cabinet %s. Your form goes in cabinet %s.
narration.supernaturalcraft.chuck.chapte: And then there was nothing left to write. Only the hunter, and a blank page.
In the beginning, there was a garden. And a hunter, who didn't belong in it.
And the garden burned, and the hunter went down into the Pit.
And every story ever written came back to read the last one.
And the Author put down his pen, and became the light.
And the hunter knelt before his God.
And the hunter could not bear to look at him.
And the hunter stood perfectly still.
narration.supernaturalcraft.chuck.writin: Give me a second. The second draft is always harder.
Hold on, I'm in the zone.
You know what's hard? Endings. Endings are hard.
Every story needs a setting. This one needs a better one.
I've rewritten this scene a thousand times. You never noticed.
power.supernaturalcraft.angel_blade.desc: A blade drops from your sleeve for a minute, bound to you: dropped, it is gone. Cast again with it in hand to dash.
power.supernaturalcraft.angel_radio.desc: For 20 seconds, demons and bosses within 128 blocks whisper where they are.
power.supernaturalcraft.ascend.desc: Up to your plot of Heaven, with the friends who kneel within 6 blocks. In Heaven, it takes everyone back down the way they came. Not in the middle of a fight.
power.supernaturalcraft.black_eyes.desc: You see in the dark. Your eyes show when you use your powers, and villagers run from them.
power.supernaturalcraft.bloodlust.desc: The Mark of Cain's Thirst: past half, your Corruption drains and stops refilling; at full, the Mark feeds on your health.
power.supernaturalcraft.descend.desc: Down to Hell, with the friends who kneel within 6 blocks. In Hell, it takes everyone back up to where they sleep: a King's way out. Not in the middle of a fight.
power.supernaturalcraft.dominion.desc: Demons and hellhounds obey the King: they never turn on you, and whatever strikes you has every demon near after it.
power.supernaturalcraft.fire_immunity.de: Fire and lava do not burn you.
power.supernaturalcraft.first_blade.desc: The First Blade answers the Mark its Knight bears: it strikes three times as hard in your hand, and its hunger gives way to the Mark's Thirst.
power.supernaturalcraft.flame_wave.desc: A wave of hellfire rolls out ahead of you, and the ground it crossed burns on for 5 seconds.
power.supernaturalcraft.healing_touch.de: Two fingers to the brow of what you look at (or your own): heals four hearts and cures poison and wither. A demon burns instead.
power.supernaturalcraft.hellfire_burst.d: A ring of hellfire bursts out of you: it burns everything within 5 blocks and throws it back.
power.supernaturalcraft.holy_chains.desc: Chains of light bind what you look at in place for 4 seconds. A boss is only slowed.
power.supernaturalcraft.host_squad.desc: A captain and four soldiers of the Host answer you for a minute: they follow you, fight what you fight and hunt demons.
power.supernaturalcraft.hunter_edge.desc: Your demon-bane weapons strike a fifth harder against anything supernatural.
power.supernaturalcraft.hunter_mana.desc: 25 more mana for each rank, as every road gives. (Every human's rites already cost a quarter less and allow longer to recite.)
power.supernaturalcraft.hunter_sense.des: You feel the supernatural within 24 blocks: it is marked for you.
A golden circle where you look; a moment later a pillar of light falls on it. Demons burn in it.
power.supernaturalcraft.kill_regen.desc: Every kill heals you two hearts.
power.supernaturalcraft.light_lance.desc: A lance of light thrown where you look; it strikes hard.
power.supernaturalcraft.maw_of_hell.desc: Hell opens where you look for 5 seconds: it drags in everything within 7 blocks and burns what reaches its heart.
power.supernaturalcraft.memory_wipe.desc: Everything within 12 blocks forgets whom it was fighting and cannot set its mind on you for 10 seconds. Bosses remember; a player of the other side is only dazed.
power.supernaturalcraft.possess.desc: Ride a creature for 20 seconds: it fights for you while you wait inside it, untouchable.
power.supernaturalcraft.shadow_step.desc: Step out of the shadow behind what you look at: its next wound, from anyone, cuts half again as deep.
power.supernaturalcraft.smite.desc: A palm to the face of what you look at: holy fire through the eyes. A lesser demon does not survive it.
power.supernaturalcraft.smoke.desc: Pour out as smoke and rush up to 12 blocks where you look, untouchable on the way. Not while held by a trap.
power.supernaturalcraft.snap.desc: An archangel snaps their fingers: every foe within 8 blocks bursts. The lesser do not survive it; the great are hurt; the innocent are spared.
power.supernaturalcraft.strangle.desc: Close a throat from afar: what you look at hangs choking in the air for 3 seconds. Not a boss, nothing too great.
power.supernaturalcraft.summon_hound.des: A bound hellhound fights at your side for a minute.
power.supernaturalcraft.telekinesis.desc: Seize what you look at; it hangs before you. Cast again to hurl it where you look.
power.supernaturalcraft.teleport.desc: Blink up to 16 blocks where you look, in a flutter of unseen wings. Not while held by a trap.
power.supernaturalcraft.throne.desc: Every creature within 12 blocks is brought to its knees for 8 seconds.
power.supernaturalcraft.true_form.desc: For 10 seconds light pours out of you: everything near that sees it is blinded, and demons burn.
power.supernaturalcraft.wings.desc: Flight with stamina, as Michael's Grace gives the Seraph Wings, with no wings to wear.
power.supernaturalcraft.yellow_eyes.desc: A Prince's eyes. From this rank you need neither food nor sleep.
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.amara_wel: What weakens Amara while it burns?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.angel_fir: What fire does an angel fear?
Whose blood forges the Key to the Cage?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.chorus_we: In what weather is the Broken Chorus woken?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.colt_bull: How many chambers has the Colt?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.colt_roun: How many Colt rounds does one rite forge?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.cracked_k: What does Lucifer leave behind if he wins?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.darkness_: When can the Darkness be called?
What comes for you when a deal falls due?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.deal_seal: How is a crossroads deal sealed?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.death_clo: What winds your clock back against Death?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.death_rin: Win or lose, what does Death give back?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.famine_fo: What happens to food you eat near Famine?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.first_dem: Who was the very first demon?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.ghost_res: How is a ghost laid to rest for good?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.hellhound: What shows a hellhound for what it is?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.host_capt: What breaks the ranks of the Host of Heaven?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.human_fre: What does a hunter who stays human keep?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.hymn_note: How many notes wake the Broken Chorus?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.last_seal: Who was the last of the sixty-six seals?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.lilith_li: What should stand between you and Lilith's light?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.lucifer_l: What is Lucifer's last face before the end?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.metatron_: What do you write in a book to call Metatron?
Which of these is one of Metatron's Words?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.michael_a: What does Michael ask you for?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.michael_t: Where does Michael's true form stand up?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.pestilenc: What is the only thing that takes Pestilence's flies?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.salt_line: What can never cross a line of salt?
quiz.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.starting_: How much mana does a hunter start with?
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.hint: With Cain and three Horsemen down, call the last Knight of Hell by night: a great circle, bound blood, the First Blade to wake it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.name: Abaddon
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.amara.hint: Under the eclipse, draw a void circle and wake the Darkness with a nether star.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.amara.name: Amara
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_1.hint: Receive Grace by day in the Overworld: the Vial of Grace, two holy water and four gold, with an Angel Blade to raise it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_1.name: Lesser Angel
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_2.hint: Ascend with a Damned Contract, three choir shards and the Seraph Wings: your own wings will carry you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_2.name: Seraph
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_3.hint: By day, give up Lucifer's Grace and an Archangel Blade to become an archangel.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_3.name: Archangel
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_4.hint: Usurp the Host: Michael's Grace and a Fallen Star, with Michael's Lance to command them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.angel_4.name: General of the Host
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.ascension.hint: Forge the first Ascension Shard by night (demon blood, embers, salt, quartz; an amethyst lights it). The great enemies leave the rest: raise your weapon and Hunter's Gear at the Hellforge, one tier at a time.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.ascension.name: Ascension
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.azazel.hint: Draw a great circle in blood chalk with lit black candles, offer demon blood, sulfur and salt by night, and call the Yellow-Eyed Demon.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.azazel.name: Azazel
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.azazel_blood.h: The Yellow-Eyed Demon bleeds when he falls. Gather what he leaves behind.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.black_eyes.hin: Demons walk the night with black eyes. Kill one and take its blood.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_adept.hin: Keep at it until you are an Adept: third-tier pages open to you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_apprentic: Practise one school of magic until you are its Apprentice: sigils, bowl spells and rites all train it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bags.hint: Mix a hex bag: hide a curse near your enemy, or carry a ward to keep demons off you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bags.name: A Bag in Hand
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bind_bani: Learn to hold a creature to the bowl, or to send demons, hounds and ghosts back where they came from.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_blood_via: Use an empty bottle on someone to draw their blood, or on the air to draw your own. The smoke follows blood.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bound_blo: Bind a vial of someone's blood to them in the bowl, with redstone and string. Lilith's contract is signed in it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bowl.hint: Hammer copper around a little gold into a spell bowl, and set it down where you mean to work.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_bowl.name: A Bronze Bowl
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_chrism.hi: Bless holy oil in the bowl with holy water and a glistering melon. The angel blade and Metatron ask for it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_concealme: Learn to hide from demons, angels, hounds and spirits. Never from the great ones.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_control.h: Learn to bind, banish or compel by name, or to break a hex.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_curses.hi: Learn a curse: misfortune, pain, frailty, rot or silence. Never on the great ones.
Learn Rowena's Familiar Bond and bind a cat or parrot you tamed to you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_first_spe: Fill the bowl with what a page asks for, light it, and recite the words without stumbling.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_first_tar: Cast a bowl spell aimed at someone, named by their blood or a taglock of their hair.
Learn to bind a curse into a pouch, or a ward against demons.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_hexed_ink: Steep Enochian ink in a potion with gold, blaze powder, amethyst or salt: what it steeps in decides its school.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_liquids.h: Every spell wants its liquids: water, holy water, demon blood, a vial of someone's blood, honey.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_locate.hi: Learn to send smoke after what you seek: a person, a pet, a grave, a spire.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_master.hi: Become a Master of one school, and read its Master's pages.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_name_ward: Learn the Ward of the Name or the Mirror Hex, before someone else learns their curses.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_page.hint: The words are written on spell pages: demons carry them, old chests hide them, librarians sell them and graves give them up.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_page.name: Spell Pages
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_pet_colla: Stitch a collar from leather, string and an iron nugget and put it on a pet you have tamed.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_purificat: Learn to cleanse curses, possession and restless spirits, and to break a crossroads deal.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_revive_pe: Learn to call a fallen pet back by its collar.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_salt_and_: Now you can see the dead: find a restless one's bones, salt them and burn them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_second_si: Learn to see what hides: ghosts, hellhounds, hex bags tucked away.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_summon_cr: Learn the words that bring a crossroads demon to you. Think twice before you say them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.bowl_taglock.h: Twist paper and string into taglocks and snip a lock of someone's hair. In the bowl it names whom the spell is for.
Learn Locate Being, Scrying or Trace the Familiar: find anyone at all, see where they stand, or follow a witch.
Arm the spire's choir altar with the Shattered Hymn and ring its bells. Listen for the wrong note.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.cain.hint: Learn from Rowena where Cain keeps his bees, find his farm, and if you dare, challenge him at night.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.cain.name: Cain
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.chuck.hint: When you are ready, tell him. He will test you, chapter by chapter, and write your ending.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.chuck.name: The Author
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_beekeepe: Follow the address Rowena wrote down to a farm at the end of the roads, and talk to the man among the hives.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_cain.hin: If you dare, challenge him at night in his yard.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_card.hin: Some coven witches carry an embossed card in green ink. Take one off them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_choice.h: With Abaddon dead and her Book in your pack, speak of it to Rowena. Give it to her, or keep it. Either way it is final.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_church.h: Find an abandoned church and consecrate it: chrism, holy water and white candles where its altar stood.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_clue.hin: Once Lucifer is back in his box, ask Rowena where Cain is.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_gave.hin: Give her the Book, and she stands with you against the Grand Coven.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_grand_wi: Ask Rowena how to call the Grand Coven, then call them by night and break their channel.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_hedge.hi: Witches walk the forests, swamps and taiga at night. Find one, and keep your hair to yourself.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_hexed.hi: Free a hexed villager with Break Hex or a salt round instead of killing it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_honey.hi: Ask him for a jar of honey. He gives one a day.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_kept.hin: Keep the Book, and she will want it back.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_marked.h: As he kneels he offers the Mark. Take it, or come back for it at his grave. It is not a gift.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_rowena.h: Follow the card's ink to a house at a forest's edge, and knock. She teaches, for a price.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_rowena_f: Read the Book in her house at night, and break her bowls before she finishes reciting.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_unmarked: The witch who outlived your fight can read the cure from the Book. Bring a vial of your own bound blood, and the Book itself if you kept it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.coven_witch.hi: Find a covenstead in a swamp, a dark forest or old taiga, and the coven witch who leads it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.crossroads_of_: Every hunter is human, and free. Heaven may call, Hell may bargain, or you may stay what you are and climb the hunter's ranks.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.death.hint: Offer him the three rings in a great circle and wake it with the Soul Scythe. Keep hitting him: your clock is running.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.death.name: Death
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_1.hint: Let the hounds take a soul bound to the crossroads and rise from it a demon, or ask the demon to make you one.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_1.name: Crossroads Demon
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_2.hint: By night in the Overworld: Azazel's blood, a choir shard and two demon blood make a Prince of Hell.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_2.name: Prince of Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_3.hint: Bearing the Mark of Cain, rise with the Angel Tablet and two demon blood, the First Blade to raise it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_3.name: Knight of Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_4.hint: Usurp the throne on the dais of Lucifer's Cage: a Fallen Star and Michael's Grace.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.demon_4.name: King of Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.devils_trap.hi: Bind demon blood, salt, paper and red dye in a binding circle to paint a devil's trap.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.eclipse.hint: Darken the sun: crying obsidian, black dye, an ender eye and demon blood in a great circle, by day.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.eclipse.name: The Eclipse
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.famine.hint: Rotten flesh, bread, wheat and salt in a great circle. Don't eat near him; kill his thralls before he does.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.famine.name: Famine
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.find_the_autho: With every great enemy beaten, a page falls at your feet. Cast its spell in the bowl: it draws a map to a cabin very far away.
Hold all four rings, each won from its Horseman.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.hint: After Lucifer, somebody starts playing harmless pranks. Notice three, cook his bait in a small circle, then lay holy oil, cake and sugar by night and wake it with the bait. Optional: nothing else needs him.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.gabriel.name: The Trickster
He leaves one piece of his armour each time he falls. Beat him four times to wear it whole.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grace.hint: An archangel's grace spills when Lucifer dies. Claim it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grace.name: Lucifer's Grace
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grand_witch.hi: Gave Rowena the Book? Call the Grand Coven by night with her calling card in a great circle, and break their channel. Optional.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.hint: Bind a grimoire and fill its pages with the sigils you find.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.name: The Grimoire
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.heaven_gate.hi: With Metatron fallen, open a gate of light by day in a grace circle (a vial of Grace, two choir shards, two holy water, a golden apple, two feathers; an angel blade wakes it) and cross it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.heeded_the_cal: After your first victory over Azazel, Heaven sends a messenger at dawn. Hear him out and take the Vial of Grace.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hell.hint: Reforge the cracked Key, then open a rift into Hell: a void circle by night, or a great circle in the Nether.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hell.name: Highway to Hell
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hellfire_ember: Hold a demon in a devil's trap and exorcise it with salt and holy water in a blood circle. Keep the ember it leaves.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.henry.hint: At dawn after Lucifer falls, a man in a fedora comes calling. Hear Henry Winchester out, and take the key.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.henry.name: The Men of Letters
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.holy_water.hin: Lay water bottles and salt in a small circle around the altar and light it to consecrate holy water.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_1.hint: Swear the hunter's oath at the altar: a Colt bullet, four salt, two holy water and a silver machete. Only a human sworn to no side may take it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_1.name: Hunter
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_2.hint: By night, keep the veteran's vigil with what is left of Lilith and of Metatron: their trophies.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_2.name: Veteran
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_3.hint: Become a legend of the road: the four Horsemen's rings and a Fallen Star on the altar.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hunter_3.name: Legend
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_ash.hint: Go through the road door at the edge of your island. Ash is behind the bar, and he knows a thing or two.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_ash.name: The Roadhouse
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_gate.hint: By day in the Overworld, lay the offering in a grace circle and wake it with an angel blade. Cross the gate of light before it fades.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_gate.name: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_home.hint: His fall breaks the seal on your house. Go in and rest by the hearth.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_home.name: Home Sweet Heaven
From now on a smaller rite, at any hour, opens a gate of light straight to your front door.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_memory.hint: Step through a shrine's veil and your memory is staged again. Touch the figure that glows to gather it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_memory.name: Memory Lane
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_metatron.hi: Heaven's door has had no keeper since Metatron fell. Bring him down first.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_naomi.hint: Cut down her guards, spare the kneeling copies, and if she straps you in, press jump as fast as you can.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_naomi.name: Naomi
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_naomi_spoil: Her drill bends a creature's will after three strikes; her diadem keeps your mind your own.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_offering.hi: The gate wants a vial of Grace, two choir shards, two holy water, a golden apple and two feathers.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_office.hint: With Naomi down, the lift at the back of her room goes up. The office does not end.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_office.name: The Office Upstairs
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_wing.hint: Gather three memories and the golden seal over the white wing opens. Somebody works in there.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_wing.name: The White Wing
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_zachariah.h: File every form he hands you in the cabinet with its number. From his third phase, read the docket.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hv_zachariah_s: His blade files what it strikes; his seal takes the edge off a great enemy's first blow.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.hymnal_spire.h: Turn a map into a hymnal map in a small circle and follow it to a spire high in the mountains.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.key_to_the_cag: By night, forge Azazel's blood, hellfire embers, gold and a nether star in a great circle.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.last_seal.hint: Lilith is the last seal. Take it from her when she breaks.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.last_seal.name: The Last Seal
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_aspiran: Beat Lucifer, then wait for dawn. Henry Winchester will offer you the Legacy: take the key.
Follow Henry's map to the stone hut, open the vault door with the key and go down to the library.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_case_cl: Solve cases for field notes and cursed artifacts. Identify an artifact at a desk before you trust it.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_first_c: Talk to Henry by the war room's map table and ask for a case. Read the file, follow the map.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_initiat: Finish five pieces of research at the desks. Kill as a member to gather field notes.
Seventy pieces of research, of five kinds. The Aquarian Star lets you run one more at once.
Thirty-five pieces of research, of at least four kinds. Henry's own case is yours.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_ring.hi: The order's ring comes with the rank of Initiate: carry it and research runs faster.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_scholar: Fifteen pieces of research, of at least three kinds.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_shapesh: Anyone could be one. Silver, Second Sight or the Spellwright's Spectacles show it for what it is.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_vampire: A nest in a barn or a mine. Dead man's blood stops one; only taking its head keeps it down.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.legacy_werewol: A man by day, a wolf by night. Bring silver, or it will only run away to heal.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lilith.hint: With Azazel dead, call the first demon by night: demon blood, hellfire embers, bones and a vial of bound blood in a great circle.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lilith.name: Lilith
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lucifer.hint: Lay the Last Seal, demon blood, embers and holy water in a great circle by night and turn the Key to the Cage.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lucifer.name: Lucifer
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.lucifer_uncage: Bring the four rings and the Key to the dais of the Cage in Hell. Put him back in the box.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.marked.hint: Only Cain can give it: beat him at night in his yard and take it as he kneels, or later at his grave.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.marked.name: The Mark of Cain
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.metatron.hint: With the Chorus silenced, write his name in a book, lay it in a great circle with choir shards, chrism, holy water and feathers by night, and he will answer.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.metatron.name: Metatron
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.michael.hint: By day, offer the Angel Tablet and the Seraph Wings in a great circle and wake it with an angel blade. Never give him your yes lightly.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.michael.name: Michael
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.naomi.hint: Gather three memories in your Heaven and the white wing opens. Spare the kneeling copies, and don't stay in her chair. Optional: nothing else needs her.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.naomi.name: Naomi
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.pestilence.hin: A fermented spider eye, mushrooms and clotted blood in a great circle. Drink his antidote, burn his flies.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.raphael.hint: With War, Famine and Pestilence beaten, wait for a thunderstorm. In a grace circle lay two holy oils, a lightning rod, a glistering melon, a golden apple and two feathers, and wake it with an angel blade. Optional: nothing else needs him.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.raphael.name: Raphael
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.rituals.hint: Raise a ritual altar and chalk a circle around it. Every rite starts there.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.rituals.name: The Ritual Altar
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.rowena_fight.h: Kept the Book of the Damned from her? Read it in her house at night, and she comes to take it back. Optional.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.salt.hint: Every hunt starts with salt. Dig rock salt out of the stone and keep some on you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.salt.name: Salt
Find where a ghost's bones lie, salt them and burn them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.shattered_hymn: Search the spire for a Shattered Hymn, or ink one in a great circle with a feather.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.soul_bound.hin: At the crossroads, tick "Bind my soul" before you seal a deal, or wish to be made one of them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.the_author.hin: Follow the map to the cabin at the end of the world and talk to the man at the typewriter.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.the_colt.hint: Lucifer falls with the gun that can kill anything. Pick it up; its rounds are forged by night.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.the_colt.name: The Colt
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.war.hint: Swords, gunpowder and demon blood in a great circle, lit with flint and steel. Parry, break his standards, trust no demon.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.war.name: War
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.wings_of_heave: Wear the Seraph Wings and take in Michael's Grace: they will carry you.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_bowl.hint: Most deals start at a spell bowl. Cast your first spell.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_bowl.name: Words of Power
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_break.hint: Purification can break a deal: holy water, the contract, salt and a hellfire ember. The demon will come back angry.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_break.name: Breaking the Deal
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_damned_cont: The demon wants paper it can sign: occultists carry damned contracts, Lilith keeps them, Crowley's cells hide them.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_deal.hint: By night, fill the bowl with demon blood, a bone, grave dirt, a daisy and the contract, say the words, and choose a wish.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_deal.name: Sealed with a Kiss
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_debt_paid.h: Survive the hunt, or kill the demon before the debt falls due. Die, and they take what they came for.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_hounds.hint: When the debt falls due, the hounds come for you. You will not see them coming.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_hounds.name: When the Hounds Come
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_summoning.h: Find the spell page that teaches the crossroads summoning.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_wild_crossr: Out in open country, two dirt roads cross over a patch of dark soil. Fill a crossroads box: a bone, grave soil, paper, sulfur and an iron nugget.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.xr_wild_deal.h: Bury the box in the soil and the demon walks up the road. Better wishes than the bowl's, for half the time and a bigger pack.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.hint: Take the lift from Naomi's room up to his office. File every form he hands you, and read the docket. Optional: nothing else needs him.
roadmap.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.name: Zachariah
rule.supernaturalcraft.gravity_inverted: And the sky became the floor.
rule.supernaturalcraft.light_hurts: And the light was not good.
rule.supernaturalcraft.unknown: And nothing changed. Or did it?
screen.supernaturalcraft.allegiance.whee: A hunter's gifts work on their own
screen.supernaturalcraft.ash.nothing: "Pull up a stool. Nothing's chasing you up here."
screen.supernaturalcraft.ash.title: HARVELLE'S ROADHOUSE
screen.supernaturalcraft.ash.visits_off: Nobody visits anybody up here. House rules.
screen.supernaturalcraft.author: The Author
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.home.alleg: Cured: may choose again in %s days
Click to see it on the roadmap
What the crossroads gave you, for good.
The hounds are loose. Run, or stand your ground.
The demon who holds your contract walks again. Kill it.
Due in %s hours. Listen for the dogs.
No deal. Keep it that way.
Due: they have come to collect
Settled. You got away with it
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.home.grace: Lucifer's light burns in you: fifty more mana, and every school's pages read as an Adept's.
The road is walked. Nothing left but you.
Open the road to the Cage
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.home.void_: You drank the Eclipse Sight: the dark no longer blinds you, and your mana runs deeper.
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.memories.h: A haze of light, waiting for you to remember.
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.memories.l: Only light: some memories are a feeling more than a place.
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.memories.n: Nothing here yet. Heaven remembers what you live through: hunt, deal, fight, lose, and it will be written.
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.memories.p: Relived at its shrine, and kept.
Not yet relived. Step through its shrine's veil in your Heaven and touch what glows to gather it.
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.roadmap.co: Drag to move, scroll to zoom
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.roadmap.fo: Forsaken: you are sworn to Heaven
Forsaken: you are sworn to Hell
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.roadmap.ne: Centre the map on your next objective
screen.supernaturalcraft.book.roadmap.th: Every step of this road is walked.

screen.supernaturalcraft.case.distance: Roughly %s blocks %s of here, near X %s, Z %s.
screen.supernaturalcraft.case.missing: This file is closed and filed away.
screen.supernaturalcraft.composer.incomp: Needs a form and an effect
screen.supernaturalcraft.composer.name: Spell name
Should the hounds come for you and take you, you will not lose what you were owed: you will rise one of us.
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.hint: Choose a wish. Mind the term.
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.0: "Everybody wants something. Let's not pretend you're the exception."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.1: "Ten years used to be standard. Times are hard, darling."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.2: "Relax. Nobody reads the fine print anyway."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.3: "You called me. I'd hate to think I dressed up for nothing."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.4: "Your soul for your heart's desire. Fair's fair."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.line.5: "Tick tock. The dogs get restless when I wait."
screen.supernaturalcraft.deal.nothing: "I've got nothing you want. Imagine that."
"A box in the dirt, the old way. I do love a traditionalist."
"Out here the menu's better. The prices, well... they're out here too."
"No bowl, no candles, no middleman. Just you, me and the dogs."
"I've already ticked the little box for you. Saves time."
screen.supernaturalcraft.henry.name: Henry Winchester
screen.supernaturalcraft.michael.ask.bod: "Let me in. You'll feel what I feel: the whole of Heaven, behind one sword."
screen.supernaturalcraft.recitation.hint: Type the words. Accents and spaces are optional; Esc abandons.
screen.supernaturalcraft.research.empty: Nothing on the board. Take field notes in the field, and come back.
screen.supernaturalcraft.research.missin: You don't carry all of it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.banishing.desc: Drawn in blood: an angel struck by it is flung far away and loses its Grace; a lesser angel is sent back to Heaven.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bolt.desc: A thrown sigil that flies straight and breaks on the first thing it meets.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.bolt.source: Known from the start: the first spell cast from a grimoire teaches it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.brimstone.desc: A cloud of burning sulphur that keeps scorching whoever stays in it. Burns sulfur.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.burst.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.chain.desc: Leaps to the first thing in your line, then on to three more nearby.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.echo.desc: The spell repeats itself a moment later.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.echo.source: Lucifer's defeat leaves its page. Only an Adept, or one with Morningstar's Spark, can read it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.empower.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.exorcise.desc: Agony to demons. A trapped demon is cast out entirely. Burns salt.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.exorcise.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.extend.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.formula.desc: A formula the Men of Letters worked out from %s: the same working, other numbers.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.formula.source: Your own research at a desk in the bunker.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.frost.desc: Slows and freezes. Turns still water to ice.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.frost.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.glamour.desc: You slip from sight, and whatever hunted you turns on its own.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.glyph.desc: A sigil laid on the floor. It waits until a foe steps on it. Three at most.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.halo.desc: A shield of light around you and your allies.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.hellchain.desc: A chain of hellfire that drags the target to you.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.hellfire.desc: Burns flesh. Burns a pinch of sulfur.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.hellfire.source: Slain demons' pages, and the cells of Crowley's Corridors in Hell.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.hex.desc: Lays a jinx on the target.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.judgement.desc: A Master's sigil. A moment later a column of light falls where it marked. Burns holy water.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.linger.desc: Where the spell lands it leaves a zone that repeats it for a few seconds.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.mend.source: Known from the start: the first spell cast from a grimoire teaches it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.pain.desc: Pain that no armour stops, and a limp.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.quicken.desc: Much shorter cooldown, at a greater cost in mana.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.radiance.desc: A blinding flash of Heaven's light. Burns the unholy.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.repel.desc: Hurls the target away from you.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.repel.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.reveal.desc: Strips invisibility, outlines the target and unmasks illusions.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.reveal.source: Pages torn from slain demons: 1 in 12, or 1 in 4 from Demon Occultists.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.salt_shot.desc: A blast of rock salt: scatters ghosts, breaks possessions, stings demons. Burns salt.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.silver_edge.desc: Your next three blows count as silver.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.smite.desc: Holy force. Twice as hard against demons and the dead.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.smite.source: Known from the start (a grimoire teaches it). Lucifer Uncaged drops a page.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.snare.desc: A hunter's snare: holds a demon for a breath, roots anything else to the spot.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.snare.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.soul_rend.desc: Tears at the soul. You drink half the harm it does.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.touch.desc: Whatever is within arm's reach. Helpful spells fall back on yourself.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.touch.source: Known from the start: the first spell cast from a grimoire teaches it.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.ward.desc: A circle at your feet that keeps working and stops hostile projectiles.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.ward.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.widen.desc: Spreads the effect over an area.
sigil.supernaturalcraft.widen.source: A rarer page from slain demons; Demon Occultists drop one in four.

subtitles.supernaturalcraft.crossroads.w: A demon comes to the crossroads
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.choru: A face of the Chorus sings
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.chuck: An old enemy is written in ink

A soldier of the Host burns out
A soldier of the Host is hurt
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.entity.hunte: Hunters step out of the light
The Grand Witch vanishes in smoke
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.item.general: A wing of light takes the blow
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.raphael.ambi: Raphael breathes, the storm with him
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.raphael.arri: Raphael comes down in a bolt
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.raphael.deat: The archangel of the storm falls
subtitles.supernaturalcraft.raphael.snap: Fingers snap, and the air bursts
