title.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.death.su: The last Knight of Hell burns from the inside out
title.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.phase1.s: The last of the Knights. She has waited a very long time.
title.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.phase2.s: Her vessel is only a coat. She can wear another.
title.supernaturalcraft.abaddon.phase3.s: The seal Cain gave them burns in her palm
title.supernaturalcraft.cain.death.sub: The first murderer kneels in his own field
title.supernaturalcraft.cain.phase1.sub: An old man sets down his smoker. The bees go quiet.
title.supernaturalcraft.cain.phase2.sub: It burns on his arm, and it is hungry
title.supernaturalcraft.cain.phase3.sub: He takes up the First Blade again
title.supernaturalcraft.grand_witch.deat: Rowena watches, and for once she doesn't gloat
title.supernaturalcraft.grand_witch.phas: Three sisters channel into her. Break the channel.
Frost, fire and an unseen fist
She holds a lock of everyone's hair. Stand in Rowena's circles.
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.death.su: "I was a good son. I did everything He asked."
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.phase2.s: The Host of Heaven takes the field.
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.phase5.s: The vessel burns away. The Sword of Heaven stands.
title.supernaturalcraft.michael.phase6.s: His halo breaks. He will not yield.
His lance, his grace, and a piece of his armour are yours.
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.death.su: Raphael falls, and leaves his wings burnt on the floor
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.phase1.s: Raphael, archangel of the Lord, has come down to finish it
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.phase2.s: His garrison holds him up: cut the threads
title.supernaturalcraft.raphael.phase3.s: The roof is gone, and the sky is his
title.supernaturalcraft.rowena.death.sub: For now. She always did have a way of coming back.
title.supernaturalcraft.rowena.phase1.su: Three hundred years of spite, in her own house
title.supernaturalcraft.rowena.phase2.su: Kill the bird. Free the poor souls — don't kill them.
title.supernaturalcraft.rowena.phase3.su: Break the bowls before she finishes the spell
title.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.dissol: Walls, desks and ceiling go up into golden light
title.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.phase1: Zachariah will see you now. Please have your forms ready
title.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.phase2: Your file is under review. The office rearranges itself
title.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.phase3: Read the docket: he does exactly what it says. Almost
title.supernaturalcraft.zachariah.phase4: The office falls away: there is only Heaven, and his verdict
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.abyssal_shard: Rock from the walls of the Pit, cold as the Cage.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.angel_tablet: The word of God, cut in stone. It still burns.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.angel_tablet.u: Use: rewrites your story; healed whole, every harm undone (2 min)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.antidote_vial: Cures the plague; none for 15 s
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.approval_stamp: Use in Zachariah's office: files your Heavenly Form at once, whatever its cabinet.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.aquarian_star: One more research desk at once while you carry it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.archangel_blad: Use: smite everything before you (%s mana)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.ascension_shar: At the Hellforge, beside what it raises
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.authors_pen: Rewrites a small corner of the world. Each rewrite takes a while to dry.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.authors_pen.sn: Sneak and use to change what it rewrites
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.azazel_blood: He fed it to the special children in their cribs.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.blood_vial.hin: Poured into a spell bowl, it leads back to its owner
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.book_of_the_da: Bound in skin, written in blood. The darkest spells ever set down.
It holds the cure for the Mark of Cain — for a witch who can read it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.borrowed_lance: It burns in your hand. Throw it back at him!
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.bunker_key: Opens and shuts the bunker's door.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.cains_address: In Rowena's elegant hand: "Bees. End of the roads. Knock."
Use it to see which way his farm lies
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.cains_honey: From the Father of Murder's hives. Eaten by a bearer of the Mark, it quiets a quarter of its Thirst.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.case_file: Use to read the brief; crouch and use for a new map of the place.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.choir_shard: A piece of a wheel that once turned before the Throne. An eye still watches from it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.colt_bullet: Consecrated. Forged by night in a blood circle, eight at a time.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.crossroads_box: Bury it at night in the trodden earth where two old roads cross. Someone will come.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.crossroads_con: Due in %s hours. Listen for the dogs
Void: the demon who held it is dead
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.curse_bag: Curses whoever lingers near it, all but its maker
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.curse_bag.slip: Hide it, tuck it in a chest, or sneak-use it on a player
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.cursed_artifac: Works in the off hand or worn as a charm.
What it does is anyone's guess. Research it at a desk.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.damned_contrac: Signed in blood. Ten years, then the hounds come.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.dead_mans_bloo: Use on a vampire to stun it, or with a blade in the other hand to smear it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.eclipse_sight: Drink to be marked: darkness and blindness cannot take you, the eclipse cannot hide the world, +25 mana.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.ectoplasm: What a scattered ghost leaves behind. Cold, and faintly moving.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.fallen_star: What is left when the Morning Star falls.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.field_notes.ar: Sigils and rites half understood. Pays for formulae and rites.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.field_notes.cr: What you saw of it, and how it died. Pays for its file at a research desk.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.field_notes.fi: A member files these in their Archive on picking them up or using them.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.field_notes.pl: Old maps and older stories. Pays for the archive's lore.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.field_notes.re: Notes on cursed things. Pays for identifying artifacts.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.gabriel_blade: Now and then, two doubles of you strike beside you
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.general_armor: Michael's own. The whole set wards off holy harm and raises a wing of light.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.grave_dirt: Earth from over the dead. Hex bags and darker rites want it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.grimoire.hint: Use to cast · Sneak-use to compose · Sneak+scroll to turn pages
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.harvests_blood: Demons slain with it always bleed
A blank Heavenly Form. Nobody issued it, so nobody wants it.
Until it is filed your blows against Zachariah are worth a quarter.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.heavens_seal: The first blow a great enemy lands on you each minute is halved.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.heavens_seal.w: Carry it in your off hand, or wear it as a charm.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.hellhound_fang: You never saw what it came out of.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.henrys_case: Nine pockets for cursed artifacts. Loose field notes put in it are filed in your Archive.
Use: a hellhound runs at your side for a minute (%s mana)
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.hunters_amulet: Warms near the supernatural. Sigils cost 10% less while worn.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.hunters_gear: Ascends to IV at the Hellforge: harder, and Aegis against the great enemies
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.last_seal: The sixty-sixth seal. Break it, and the Cage opens.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.letters_compas: Points at your open case, or at a pin you set at a war table.
Sneak and use to follow your case again
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.lucifers_grace: Use to take it in as Morningstar's Spark: +50 maximum mana, and every school's pages read as an Adept's.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.men_of_letters: Research runs a tenth faster while you carry it.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.michael_lance: Throw it: it comes back. Twice as hard on angels and demons.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.michaels_grace: Wear the Seraph Wings and take it in: they will carry you.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.naomis_diadem: Off hand or charm: you cannot be conditioned, marked by Heaven or possessed; +3% Aegis against great enemies.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.pet_collar.hin: The link a locating or reviving spell needs
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.pet_collar.unb: Use it on a tamed animal of yours
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.protection_bag: Demons will not seek you out unless provoked; curse bags cannot touch you
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rack_hook: From the Rack, where souls are taken apart.
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rowenas_callin: Use it to see which way its ink runs
tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rowenas_grimoi: Rowena's own. It remembers the last curse you spoke at a bowl.

tooltip.supernaturalcraft.rune.blank: Carve it into a rune at a ritual altar.
